description:
Send files and text between your own devices over Wi-Fi. No account. Daak (डाक, "post") moves photos, files, and text between your own devices over your local network. Nothing goes through the internet. Nothing goes through a server. You do not create an account. Pair two devices once. Scan a QR code and check that both screens show the same number. After that, pick an item and send it. Features
  • End-to-end encryption between paired devices.
  • Local network only. No account and no internet relay.
  • Files of any size. Daak sends 1 MiB chunks, so memory use stays low.
  • Send text and photos as well as files.
  • Works with Daak on macOS and iOS.
Permissions
  • Camera: scan the QR code when you pair a device.
  • Local network and Wi-Fi multicast: find your paired devices.
  • Notifications: show the result of a transfer.
Daak receives files only while the app is running.
